title: Fully Convolutional Networks for Semantic Segmentation
venue: IEEE Computer Society Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition/Proceedings - IEEE Computer Society Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition/Proceedings

problem.summary: forward/inference backward/learning Convolutional networks are powerful visual models that yield hierarchies of features.
statements: forward/inference backward/learning Convolutional networks are powerful visual models that yield hierarchies of features.
We show that convolutional networks by themselves, trained end-to-end, pixelsto-pixels, exceed the state-of-the-art in semantic segmentation.
Our key insight is to build "fully convolutional" networks that take input of arbitrary size and produce correspondingly-sized output with efficient inference and learning.
